high_level_description: This image is a detailed illustration of flowers, primarily featuring peonies and tulips. The flowers are rendered in shades of blue, ranging from deep navy to light blue, with some white flowers interspersed. The petals are intricately detailed, showcasing the texture and layers of each bloom. The leaves are also depicted with fine lines, adding to the overall complexity and beauty of the illustration. The background is a neutral beige color, which provides a soft contrast to the vibrant blues and whites of the flowers.
